product_family: Yandex Translate: free consumer translation service (118+ languages) and enterprise API via Yandex Cloud; includes AI-powered assistance features for grammar explanation and translation recommendations.

certifications.name: ISO/IEC 27001
certifications.proof_quote: The Yandex Cloud Information Security Management System (ISMS) meets the requirements of the International Organization for Standardization (ISO) and the International Electrotechnical Commission (IEC). This is evidenced by ISO/IEC 27001, ISO/IEC 27017, ISO/IEC 27018, and ISO/IEC 42001:2023 certification.

certifications.name: ISO/IEC 27017
certifications.proof_quote: This is evidenced by ISO/IEC 27001, ISO/IEC 27017, ISO/IEC 27018, and ISO/IEC 42001:2023 certification. ISO/IEC 27017 includes a code of practice for information security control for cloud providers.

certifications.name: ISO/IEC 27018
certifications.proof_quote: This is evidenced by ISO/IEC 27001, ISO/IEC 27017, ISO/IEC 27018, and ISO/IEC 42001:2023 certification. ISO/IEC 27018 sets the requirements for the protection of personal data processed by cloud service providers.

certifications.name: ISO/IEC 42001:2023
certifications.proof_quote: This is evidenced by ISO/IEC 27001, ISO/IEC 27017, ISO/IEC 27018, and ISO/IEC 42001:2023 certification. ISO/IEC 42001:2023 lays down the artificial intelligence (AI) management system requirements.

certifications.name: PCI DSS 3.2.1
certifications.proof_quote: Yandex Cloud has a certificate of compliance with PCI DSS 3.2.1. Compliance with the standard is checked by a QSA auditor on an annual basis.

certifications.name: Cloud Security Alliance STAR Level 1
certifications.proof_quote: Yandex Cloud meets the requirements of the Security, Trust, Assurance and Risk (STAR) program at Level 1: Self-Assessment.

certifications.name: SOC 2
certifications.proof_quote: SOC 2 certification confirmed only for Yandex ID service (2020-2022 reports published). No public SOC 2 certification found for Yandex Cloud or Yandex Translate.

certifications.name: GDPR Compliance
certifications.proof_quote: If our customer is subject to the GDPR, we implement the measures necessary for them to remain compliant when using Yandex Cloud.

certifications.name: HIPAA
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of HIPAA certification or compliance framework for Yandex Translate or Yandex Cloud found in vendor documentation or security pages.

privacy.ai_training_note: Yandex.Cloud documentation explicitly states 'Yandex.Cloud doesn't use transmitted data to train its own models.' Enterprise customers can optionally provide their own data for custom model training with explicit consent. The free consumer service states that user-contributed translations can be used by Yandex in other resources and marketing materials without attribution.
privacy.data_region: Russia (primary); vendor offers a Data Processing Addendum for customers subject to GDPR. No Standard Contractual Clauses are referenced on the vendor's own domain.

security.name: Data residency
security.value: Russian Federation primary; compliant with Federal Law 152-FZ requiring Russian citizen data stored in Russia

security.name: Access controls
security.value: IAM token or API key required for API access; Yandex ID account required for certain features

security.name: Incident response
security.value: Support service available; extended plan users receive round-the-clock assistance

products.name: Yandex Translate (Free Consumer Service)
products.data_scope: User translations and contributions; user IPs and browser data via cookies
products.notes: Free, personal non-commercial use only. User-contributed data (translations, edits, error reports) can be used by Yandex across all services and in marketing materials without attribution. Governed by general Yandex Privacy Policy and Translate Terms of Use. Does not fall under enterprise compliance framework.

products.name: Yandex Translate API (Enterprise)
products.data_scope: Customer translation requests; optional custom model training data with consent
products.notes: Available through Yandex Cloud with 50,000 character/day free tier. Customer data not used by Yandex for model training unless explicitly provided for custom training. Governed by Yandex Translate API Terms and Yandex Cloud compliance standards. Enterprise customers benefit from ISO 27001/27017/27018 and PCI DSS certification of underlying infrastructure.

compare.pricing_model: Freemium (free tier: 50,000 characters/day; paid enterprise plans available via Yandex Cloud)
compare.data_residency: Primary: Russia (required for Russian citizen data per Federal Law 152-FZ); international transfers governed by the vendor's Data Processing Addendum

flags: The free Translate service is distinct from the enterprise Yandex Cloud API. The free service has minimal compliance documentation; the enterprise API inherits Yandex Cloud's certifications, but responsibility for compliance is placed on the customer per the API terms.
The API terms explicitly disclaim liability and state there is 'no guarantee' of error-free operation or service consistency; the customer bears responsibility for legal compliance.

Primary data storage is in Russia under Federal Law 152-FZ. International GDPR posture relies on the vendor's self-declared measures and a Data Processing Addendum; no Standard Contractual Clauses or EU adequacy basis is referenced on the vendor domain.
SOC 2 certification is confirmed only for the Yandex ID service (2020-2022), not for Yandex Cloud or Yandex Translate. Public SOC 2 audit reports are not available for the translation service.
No evidence of HIPAA compliance or business associate agreements for healthcare use cases.
The free service permits use of user translations in marketing materials. The enterprise service does not train on customer data by default, but opt-in custom training is available.
The free service is governed by general Yandex terms; for the enterprise API, the customer is responsible for compliance per the API terms. Compliance posture depends on which product tier is used.
